authorInfo.bio: Henry Hawley Smart (1833–1893) was an English army officer and novelist, who wrote as Capt. Hawley Smart. He was praised for his realistic racing and hunting scenes, and depictions of military incidents.

description: "Belles and Ringers" by Hawley Smart is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around Lady Mary Bloxam, who is eager to help her daughters secure suitable marriages during their social season.
